verdict.rationale: Convex documents an official CLI (`npx convex`) with a broad command set. It covers dev file-watching that pushes functions, schema and generated types; running queries, mutations and actions with `--watch`; import and export; log streaming; health insights; and local deployments, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents) and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in agentic workflows.
